findings.summary: tweet_author is interpolated into quoted YAML frontmatter without going through _yaml_str, unlike every other field touched in this diff.
findings.mechanism: tweet_author comes from the external oEmbed response (data.get("author_name", "unknown")) and is attacker-influenced. It's wrapped in literal double quotes (`author: "{tweet_author}"`) but not escaped via _yaml_str, so a value containing a `"` or backslash breaks out of the YAML double-quoted scalar and can inject arbitrary frontmatter keys — exactly the vulnerability this change was written to close, left open on this one field.
